newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to suspend, delist CRI Liquidating.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to suspend, delist CRI Liquidating.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Tuesday it will stop trading in CRI Liquidating REIT Inc prior to the opening of trading March 31.
The Exchange said that following the suspension, application will be made to the Securities and Exchnage Commission to delist the stock.
The Exchange said it is taking the action in light of the company's plan to liquidate the REIT and distribute the remaining assets.
A liquidating distribution of $1.87 per share will be made March 31 to holders of record March 20, at which point the company will have substantially reduced its operating asets.
